weaknesses_found: F5 ASSERTION HAS NO DISCRIMINATING POWER IN ITS OWN FIXTURE: test_pre_experiment_trust_round2.py:169 asserts raw_sample_preserved['all_emitted'] == len(starved), but that fixture passes the whole sample as the in-window list (starved == [{}]*20, inside_window == 20), so len(inside) == len(starved) and the assertion also passes under the pre-fix formula. It is a true statement, not a regression guard; the guard that actually kills the old formula is F4's test (0 in-window vs 3 emitted).

F3 GUARD PINS THE TWO NAMED SEEDS, NOT THE 400-SEED CLAIM: assert {222, 227} <= set(incompatible) fails for any shortening to range(1, N) with N <= 226 (measured: N=222 -> {222}, N=226 -> {222}) but passes for N >= 227, so a re-shortening of the loop to the previous range(1, 231) = 1..230 would still satisfy it. If the 'SCAN_SEEDS = 400' contract is what must not drift, assert the scan length directly (e.g. record and assert the scanned seed list == list(range(1, SCAN_SEEDS + 1)) or assert the number of reports/compiles == SCAN_SEEDS).

MULTIPLIER_IS_A_NOOP IS UNREACHABLE IN ANY RETURNED REPORT: it is computed by the same predicate that appends the 'no-op treatment' problem, and materialization_report raises on any problem, so callers only ever observe WINDOW_OBSERVED or NO_PACKET_IN_WINDOW. The branch is semantically correct and self-documenting, but it cannot be exercised by a test through the public API (I could only capture it by frame inspection at raise time); if it is meant to be part of the evidence contract, the value should also appear in the raised message (it currently does not).

PERSISTENCE GAP (carried over, unchanged): the materialization report including zero_packet_diagnostic and raw_sample_preserved is still not written to any run-dir artifact -- on-disk manifest.json has no materialization key and receipt.json does not carry it; the operator sees it only in captured stdout from __main__.py. Keeping only run directories still loses the fact that a declared burst window observed zero packets.

BASELINE STILL NOT IN GIT (carried over, unchanged): HEAD 98c858f contains no materialization_report, so the F1/F2 delta was verified against the producer's shadow copy and the round3/round4 diffs plus the current working tree; an auditor cannot pin the pre-fix behaviour to a git revision.
